about: MIT settings table written from spec §2.7.2 (L5). `expected` lists the keys that differ from `base` (the defaults in English); a key not in `base` is appended in the order given. os is the folder-path rule; language the OS language.

cases.name: not an object gives the defaults
keys come out in the fixed order whatever the input order
a known language is kept over the OS language
an unknown language falls back to the OS language
graphics with a fraction is the default
graphics as a string is the default
windowed, streamerMode, hostTools true are kept
minimizeToTray true is written after dumperDll
all three flags in fixed order
flags that are not JSON true are absent
only the true flags are written
Windows gameRoot with forward slash and lower-case drive
Windows gameRoot of four units is the shortest kept
Windows gameRoot of three units is refused
Windows gameRoot without a drive is refused
Windows gameRoot with a digit drive is refused
Windows gameRoot without a separator is refused
Linux path on Windows is refused
gameRoot of 199 units with astral characters is kept
gameRoot not a string is null
dumperDll not ending in .dll is refused
Linux gameRoot of four units is kept
Linux gameRoot of three units is refused
Windows path on Linux is refused
usernames with valid ids and names are kept in order
usernames with bad keys are dropped
usernames with bad names are dropped
usernames not an object is empty
backupOffered with bad keys is dropped
trustedRuntimes dedup comes before the cut
trustedRuntimes empty after filtering is dropped
trustedRuntimes not an array is dropped
a private server on a Tailscale address
a private server on a public host is refused
a mode other than public is private
an entry without mode is private
a public server with a fingerprint
a public server without a fingerprint is refused
a public server with a bad fingerprint is refused
a public server may use a private-mode host
a port with a fraction is refused
a port as a string is refused
a name with a control character is refused
a name with a bidi override is refused
a name over the limit is refused
a name at the limit is kept
a private share URL is kept
an invalid share URL is null
a public share URL is null
a valid invite code is kept
entry fields come out in order and unknown fields go
savedServers not an array is empty
duplicates by mode, host and port keep the first
same host and port in another mode is another server
invalid and duplicate entries do not count toward 20
the current server goes first when not listed
the current server replaces its entry in place
the current server inserted into a full list pushes the last out
the current server beyond the first 20 is moved to the front
an invalid current server is null and not listed
a current 1.4.4 server stays listed but is not current
a current 1.4.4 server replaces its entry
a complete file is kept as it is
